'''Aloor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] who worked as a [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Aloor lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dalicron-4]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. He owned a surgery called [[Doc Aloor]] in [[Dalia (township)|Dalia]], the main settlement on Dalicron-4. When the child [[Zanner]] was attacked by [[Verlen]], he was taken to Aloor. The Ithorian took him into his surgery, and after examining the child, he pronounced that he would live.
